name: Don't Touch Us
detailed_description:
Don't Touch Us

A psychological horror RPG set in the decaying halls of an abandoned hospital, Don't Touch Us plunges players into a chilling mystery filled with puzzles, exploration, and haunting revelations. Experience a gripping story of loss, revenge, and the supernatural, brought to life with realistic graphics and immersive sound design in Unreal Engine 5.

Story

Anya was murdered. Brutally. Her ghost—shattered into two—now roams the ruins of Doctor's hospital, searching for the truth. As one half of Anya’s spirit, you awaken with no memories, drawn to an eerie voice calling your name, the other half of your lost soul. Together, you must uncover the hospital’s darkest secrets, reunite as one, and confront the entity that ended your life.

But the doctor still lingers… and he’s watching.

Gameplay

  • Linear, story-driven experience – No combat, just pure psychological horror.

  • Puzzle-solving & exploration – Uncover hidden clues and items to progress.

  • Environmental effects – Different areas distort vision, warp sound, and twist reality.

  • Diverse environments – Each level introduces a new tone and visual style, from dark, oppressive halls to unsettling, empty spaces.

  • Deep RPG elements – Level-based progression tied to uncovering Anya’s past.

  • Fully voiced characters – Immerse yourself in the chilling narrative.

Features

✔ Unreal Engine 5 visuals – Realistic graphics with ray tracing, and adjustable settings.
✔ Hauntingly immersive atmosphere – Every sound and shadow hides a story.
✔ A compelling mystery – Piece together Anya’s past and seek justice.
✔ Psychological horror meets shocking scares – A constant sense of dread, broken by heart-stopping moments.

Coming Q2 2025

Wishlist now and prepare to enter the nightmare.

content_descriptors.notes:
Our game is a psychological horror experience featuring intense and graphic depictions of violence, gore, and disturbing imagery. Players will encounter scenes of extreme bloodshed, mutilated bodies, and unsettling environments designed to create a deeply immersive and terrifying atmosphere. The game includes dismemberment, torture, and other violent acts that may be disturbing to sensitive players.

While there are no depictions of sexual acts or sexual assault, the game explores dark themes such as psychological torment, insanity, and the fragility of the human mind. Some scenes may involve self-harm, distressing hallucinations, and references to traumatic experiences.

This game is intended for mature audiences only and is not suitable for players who may be sensitive to extreme violence or horror elements. Viewer discretion is strongly advised.
